data.name: Jixo 5: Mask Parade Collector’s Edition
data.detailed_description:
Jixo 5: Mask Parade invites you into a world of dazzling costumes, joyful performances, and endless celebration. Step behind the curtain and explore a vibrant carnival filled with elegant masks, colorful parades, lively theatres, magical stages, whimsical puppets, and enchanting performers. Every puzzle bursts with creativity, charm, and festive atmosphere, bringing the spirit of celebration to life in every scene.

Key Features:

  • A Carnival Puzzle Wonderland: Jump in and pick the puzzles you love most! Enjoy fresh logic challenges, vibrant object-finding scenes, creative jigsaw-style boards, and picture games, all inspired by dazzling parades, theatrical performances, elegant masks, and festive celebrations.

  • Cheerful & Relaxing Fun: Easy-going, colourful, and uplifting gameplay perfect for anyone who enjoys a cosy puzzle session filled with creativity and celebration.

  • Bonus Carnival Boxes: Open special Carnival Boxes whenever you're ready for an extra surprise. Each one offers a quick challenge and a charming new collectible.

This is a special Collector's Edition that includes exclusive extras to keep the celebration going, and you won’t find them in the standard version:

  • This premium release adds 24 additional levels and exclusive bonus games

  • Special achievements and collectibles

  • A beautiful screensaver gallery

  • Built-in Music Player featuring festive, theatrical, and atmospheric melodies
